Suggested completion goals assume balanced coverage across the 21-day window.

Math | Problem-solving, formulas, timed practice | **100% syllabus review** | 1 practice set/week; 1 timed mock
Biology | Concepts, diagrams, definitions | **100% syllabus review** | 2 revision cycles; 1 diagram recall test
History | Timelines, causes/effects, essay outlines | **100% syllabus review** | 1 timeline recap/week; 1 essay plan/week

### 3) Simple Weekly Review Layout
#### Week 1: Nov 1–7
- Goal: Build coverage and identify weak topics.
- Review tasks:
  - Math: core formulas + mixed practice
  - Biology: key systems + labeled diagrams
  - History: major events + timeline notes
- Checkpoint: 15-minute end-of-week quiz for each subject

#### Week 2: Nov 8–14
- Goal: Strengthen recall and increase timed work.
- Review tasks:
  - Math: timed drills and error log
  - Biology: short-answer practice
  - History: essay outlines and comparison questions
- Checkpoint: 1 full review session for weakest subject

#### Week 3: Nov 15–21
- Goal: Final revision and confidence building.
- Review tasks:
  - Math: mixed mock test + corrections
  - Biology: rapid recall sheets
  - History: final timeline sweep + essay skeletons
- Checkpoint: light review only on Nov 20–21

## Weekly Study Rhythm
- Weekdays: 2 hours total
  - 60 min main subject
  - 45 min secondary subject
  - 15 min quick recall or flashcards
- Weekends: 4 hours total
  - 2 focused blocks of 90 min
  - 1 shorter review block of 60 min
- Rest evening: 1 evening each week with no study, ideally after the weekly review
